tenderSchedule.title: Supply, Installation, commissioning and Comprehensive Maintenance of analogue addressable fire alarm system
tenderSchedule.description: Supply, Installation, commissioning and Comprehensive Maintenance of analogue addressable fire alarm system
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka State Natural Disaster Monitoring Centre
tenderSchedule.locationName: Karnataka State Natural Disaster Monitoring Centre Director Office Bengalore

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder / OEM should be in business related to Supply, installation and maintenance of addressable fire alarm system in India.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration certificate issued under the Companies Act by a competent authority

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder or OEM should have experience in supply, installation and maintenance of analogue addressable fire alarm system with Government Department / Public Sector Undertaking in India.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work order(s) and experience certificate(s) issued by the office/s concerned as per technical criteria in tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have a technical support centre in Karnataka with at least 3 service engineers / staff and should have an office in Karnataka and preferably in Bengaluru.
The firm or company should produce the self-attested photocopies of documents related to Company PAN Number and GST Certificate.
Document on the concept of the working principle of the analogue addressable fire alarm system has to be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder companys average annual turnover shall be equal to or more than Rs.15,00,000 and Rs.7,50,000 incase of MSME bidder during the period from 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should be authorized partner of OEM Company and authorization letter from OEM is to be submitted to KSNDMC along with the bid documents or Bidder shall be a Manufacturer.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Authorization letter from OEM or Manufacturing Certificate should be submitted

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not have been blacklisted by Government of Karnataka or its agencies for any reasons whatsoever & The bidder should not have been blacklisted by Central / any other State/UT Government or its agencies for corrupt or fraudulent practices or for indulging in unfair trade practices.

Technical product brochure is to be submitted and the same should be available on the OEMs Vendors website. (If any of the product brochure which are mentioned as mandatory is not submitted the technical bid is liable to be rejected)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Data sheet or product brochure

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Compliance statement of the specifications of analogue addressable fire alarm system as mentioned in this tender document has to be submitted to KSNDMC. (As per Annexure-9)
